name: Voice chat ducking
author: Voltage
description: Lowers the music while people talk in Discord, Legcord, TeamSpeak or Mumble, and brings it back a second after they stop.

settings.label: Starts at
settings.help: How loud a voice must be to lower the music. Sensitive also reacts to quiet speakers; Loud voices only ignores background noise and soft notification sounds.

settings.label: Listen to
options: All voice apps (also TeamSpeak, Mumble, Guilded)
